description: Before opening or merging a PR, replay a diff against memory and return ONE verdict — BLOCK / WARN / PASS — citing the decision and bug behind each invariant in scope, plus advisory blast-radius invariants, re-introduced retired code, and symbols already defined elsewhere. Deterministic, no LLM. Default: staged changes; working:true for all local changes, base (e.g. origin/main) for a PR range, commit for one commit. Not for an advisory impact map (hunch_pr_impact), or intent erosion with no diff (hunch_conformance).

base.description: Diff against this base ref (e.g. origin/main) — for a PR/branch.

commit.description: Diff a single commit (sha/ref). Omit base AND commit to check staged changes.

working.description: Include all working-tree changes vs HEAD (staged, unstaged, and untracked files).

name: hunch_merge_verdict
title: Causal merge verdict: is this change safe against the recorded WHY?
